name: How much does a single-room renovation cost in Denver and nearby areas?

mainEntity.name: How much does a single-room renovation cost in Denver and nearby areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost is driven by the room size, demolition, finish level, structural work, and whether plumbing, electrical, or HVAC changes are needed. In Denver, single-room projects can vary widely, so a detailed scope is the best way to compare value instead of only comparing the bottom-line price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on room size, finishes, and whether utilities or structure are changing. A written scope is the best way to get a realistic price and compare bids fairly.
